# Release packages

APK/AAB releases moved to GitHub Releases (the APK outgrew GitHub's
100 MB in-repo file limit at 0.14.0):

https://github.com/nowheel/RackDroid/releases

Latest sideload APK: `rackdroid-<version>-release.apk` on the newest
release. The `-playstore.aab` asset is the Play Store upload bundle.
